surface_mechanism_description: The compound Zn{N[Si(CH3)3]2}2 was used as a p-type dopant source for ZnSe. The thermal decomposition of this compound suggests that a temperature range exists in which a substantial population of the Zn-N-Si bonding arrangement present in the precursor cleaves at the desired N-Si location. The compound could be used to grow ZnSe in the presence of H2Se in the temperature range of 300-450 °C.
